guideNote: Every guide below is our own advice, written for this entry from the official description. GTA 6 released on 19 Nov 2026, so no guide has been checked in the game yet: where the official description does not pin down a place or a step, the guide says so instead of inventing one.
list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades from Exophase; PSN progress counts from PSNProfiles).

psnprofiles.label: PSNProfiles trophy list — PSN progress counts

trophies.guide: The platinum. Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own — there is no shortcut and no separate task. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, then partners and strangers, then activities and collectibles, then the crime and cleanup trophies. Check the tracker as you go, and when one trophy holds you back, open its own guide: each one says what to do and whether it can be missed.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of the game — and this pops. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss: play the opening through to its end. If you are past the opening and do not have it, finish the mission's final objective.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Nothing in the official description suggests it can be missed — it is a progress marker, not a challenge. Just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2. Play the chapter's missions in order until the chapter ends. The name is PlayStation's own, asterisks included, and the trophy is another progress marker on the road to the final mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3. Follow the story missions until the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies, it comes from playing through, not from any special task.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. Play its missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. After this, only the final mission stands between you and the story's gold trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Complete the final mission and this pops with the end of the story. It is the last story trophy: everything after it is side content and cleanup. Finish the story first, then work the roadmap's later stages — the open world stays open for everything else.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. The description names the mission, not a method, so there is no special trick — complete its objectives and move on.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story heist: expect setup work before the heist itself, then finish the job. The trophy pops when the heist mission completes, so the plan is simply to play the story until it comes up.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Child's Play. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is a story beat, not a challenge with a hidden condition.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Headliners. Play the story until Headliners appears and finish it. The description gives no extra condition, so there is nothing to do beyond completing the mission.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. Play the story until it appears and finish it. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, the free-roam airport stunt — this one is a story mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Play the story until this mission appears and finish it. The name suggests a big set-piece; the trophy itself only asks that the mission be completed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The 100% completion trophy, gold. Reach 100% completion: story, side missions, activities, collectibles and the rest, all counted by the game's own checklist. This is the last trophy most players earn before the platinum. Use the in-game stats to see what is left, and work through this guide's roadmap — every other trophy feeds into it, so by the time the rest are done, this one is close.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's driving tricks — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like — and the count builds across normal play. Drive fast, take ramps and jumps, and thread traffic; the number climbs on its own. Treat it as a background grind while you do everything else, and check the count in your stats if it feels stuck. No single spot is named in the official description, so there is no farm location to send you to yet.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. PSNProfiles lists the count as 9. Sample everything the open world offers — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest — one of each. The trophy is about breadth, not mastery: one try of each type is enough, so do it early and let it tick over while you play.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. PSNProfiles lists 42 challenges. Work through the range's challenge list and gold each one, using the weapon the challenge gives you and learning its pattern rather than forcing it. This is a skill trophy — expect to repeat the harder challenges. Gold each one as you go so you do not have to sweep all 42 at the end.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. PSNProfiles lists 14 locations. Find the drone race at each location and win it. Drone races reward clean flying over raw speed, so learn each course's line before you push for the win. Win them as you discover the locations, so the map work and the racing happen together.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any 20 distinct races count. Race everything you find — street, off-road, drone, boat — and keep a note of which you have won. The game decides what counts as a different race, so variety is the point: twenty wins in the same event will not do it.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take his fishing challenge, then out-fish him. Fishing challenges are usually about the right spot and timing rather than gear: follow the challenge's own prompts and keep your line steady. One win is all it takes.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade machine and finish a game on it. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most. A single completion is enough — no high score is needed.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand to its end. Side-character strands usually unlock as the story advances: if Andy has no mission for you yet, keep playing the story and check back. The final mission is the one that closes his strand, so do these strands as they open rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Same pattern as Andy's strand: follow Kenton's missions to the last one. The description names Kenton, not a place or a method, so the work is finding his strand and playing it through.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand to its final mission. Do the side strands alongside the story so they do not pile up into one long cleanup phase at the end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. PSNProfiles lists 8 strands. Strangers appear around the map — meet them, take their missions, and finish each strand. Explore the state and talk to everyone marked as a stranger; eight completed strands earn the silver. The five named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) have their own trophies, so these eight are the strangers beyond them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Follow Randy's strand to its final mission. Like the other named-character trophies, this is a strand to play through, not a task to hunt for in free roam.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's strand to its final mission. Five named characters have a final-mission trophy each; finishing all five strands is a solid block of the roadmap's second stage.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every one of the 18 spots across Leonida. PSNProfiles lists 18 spots. Meditation spots are scattered across the state: visit each one and meditate. Fold this into your exploration — meditate whenever you pass a spot — and use the map to sweep the ones you missed at the end.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret wants one specific animal hunted: take the hunt from him and follow his lead. Tracking and patience matter more than firepower. The description names Bret, not the animal, so the hunt itself tells you what to look for — there is no location in the official description to send you to yet.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find the collectible cards scattered around Leonida and complete three full sets. Cards are a classic GTA collectible: check shops, hidden spots and the places the game nudges you toward. Three complete sets is the bar, not every card in the game — so finish the sets you are closest to first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find 100 WAiNK spots and use the feature at each one. This is a volume collectible: sweep the map methodically, area by area, and mark off the ones you have done. The tracker here counts toward 100, so log your progress as you go rather than trying to remember a hundred spots.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game tracks challenges of many kinds: finish 50 of them. Challenges overlap with everything else you do — stunts, races, shooting, exploration — so this climbs while you chase the other trophies. If it stalls, open the challenge list and pick the easiest unfinished ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this while you have a partner. Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape the heat. You need a partner present when the wanted level is on, and partner time is limited to story segments, so do not leave this for the post-game. Get to 4 stars with your partner nearby, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. If no partner segment is active, play the story until one is.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this while you have a partner. Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level. Three robberies in a row, partner with you, wanted level intact throughout. Plan a route past three shops, keep the partner close, and do not let the wanted level drop between robberies. Like Hot Together, this needs a partner, so do it during a story segment that gives you one.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or ride 100 different vehicles and the game logs each discovery. Variety is the whole game: steal, borrow and buy different cars, bikes, boats and aircraft as you find them. A hundred sounds like a lot, but a curious player crosses it during a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus and drop five enemies before it ends. Pick a fight with a crowd: five targets in one window needs a busy spot, not a duel. Grouped enemies and a good vantage make it far easier than five separate fights.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the schedule did not plan — the description's own joke. VCIA is a place, not a mission: go there and find an unconventional way out, on foot, in a vehicle, or otherwise. Easy to overlook, because nothing in the story sends you to do it. Not missable: the airport is always there.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. The description is a joke about Rhino tanks. Get into a Rhino — or get into trouble with one — and the trophy is about surviving the encounter. Tanks appear at high wanted levels and military spots, so be ready for a fight when you go looking. The official description gives no exact trigger, so expect it to pop from dealing with a Rhino rather than from a checklist step.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. A clean jewelry robbery: in and out with no one spotting you. Plan the approach, watch the staff and cameras, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Stealth, not speed, is what this one grades — one clean run is enough.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Rob five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults are the big robberies — expect alarms and a getaway. Five successful escapes, not five attempts, so make the escape plan before you walk in, and count each clean escape in the tracker.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck, rob it, and escape. Trucks run routes around the state: hit one, take the cash, and lose the heat. One clean robbery is enough.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. PSNProfiles lists 52 areas. Visit every named area on the map. This is pure exploration — drive, fly and walk the whole state. The map fills in as you go, so sweep the corners you never had a reason to visit, and log your progress area by area.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. PSNProfiles lists 9 gangs. Find one illegal operation per gang and rob it. Nine gangs, nine robberies: learn which operation belongs to which gang and work through the list. The tracker counts gangs, not operations, so tick each gang off as you rob its operation.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment, not a challenge — the trophy is about being in the right place and doing the small thing. Easy to walk past, because nothing in the story makes you stop here. Not missable: the beach is always there.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a vehicle out through a showroom's front — the classic GTA exit. Find a vehicle showroom, get in a car, and leave through the glass. It is a specific stunt at a specific kind of place, so it is easy to miss while you are busy elsewhere. Not missable: showrooms do not close.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. The description names the alley, so go there and bowl. One visit, one game — the trophy is the follow-through, not the score.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: MISSABLE — do this while you have a partner. A partnership moment with mass appeal: the description is deliberately vague, but it is tied to doing something with a partner that draws a crowd. Like the other partner trophies, treat partner time as limited — do partnership activities while the story gives you a partner, and do not assume the moment comes back. The official description does not say exactly what the moment is, so stay alert for partnership prompts during story segments.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). PSNProfiles tracks a count to 500. Make choices — dialogue and action choices across the game — until the count reaches 500. This is a long grind, not a single decision: choose often, in missions and in the open world, and the number climbs. Nothing in the description says a choice is one-shot, so do not stress a single pick.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Succeed on a second attempt at something you failed first. The description is a shrug, not a recipe — it likely pops when a retry succeeds. Do not force it: play normally, fail something, try again, and it comes. Easy to overlook because there is no place or mission attached to it.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange. A rare or random event — the kind of weird moment GTA hides in the world. Keep your eyes open while you explore; strange encounters are the point of this one. There is no pinned location in the official description, so no guide can send you to an exact spot yet.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon. It is a specific move, not a mission: get in a vehicle, get close, and swing. Easy to miss because melee drive-bys are not something you do by accident. Not missable: you can try it any time you have a vehicle.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Launder marked bills through your contacts until you have earned $250,000. Marked bills come from robberies; your contacts clean them for a cut. Keep laundering as you rob — the total is cumulative, so it grows with every job. The tracker counts dollars toward $250,000.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spend $100,000 in shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, anything the shops sell. It is cumulative across every shop, so buy what you need as you play and the total adds up. Late in the game, big purchases close the gap fast. The tracker counts dollars toward $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. PSNProfiles lists 8 garage properties. Buy every garage property in the game. Garages are bought with in-game money, so save for them as they appear; eight purchases and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles, open the app, and register them — ten registrations is the bar. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive.
trophies.name: On the Spot
